Run the read-only preflight and attach its JSON output without credentials or cookies.
Produce one structured root contract and plan JSON; never claim that the plan was executed.

Persist state and evidence in SQLite, run bounded Worker assignments, and emit JSON evidence.
Read the evidence, distinguish PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN, and request the next safe action.
